subject: Decision: invoice emission path (portal webhook vs. signed email) and EU VAT evidence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@hightower.io>, accounts-payable@hightower.io
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Invoice emission path and VAT evidence — quick decision request

Hi Elena / AP team,

Quick question while we finalize December billing for your account: do you want Redwood to push the invoice into Hightower's AP portal via webhook/API (preferred for immediate acknowledgement), or should we send an encrypted PDF to accounts-payable@hightower.io as an email attachment?

Notes that matter on our side:
- If we push via webhook we can include structured VAT tags (reverse-charge flag, VAT ID) and get an instant 200/ack back which helps automate match/clear.
- If emailed, we can DKIM-sign and S/MIME the PDF but AP needs to confirm they accept signed email payloads and can attach the invoice to PO HWT-2219.
- We have a draft attached so you can check layout and VAT lines.

Action request: please confirm preference and send the PO number (or confirm PO HWT-2219 is correct) + the VAT ID to appear on the invoice. If portal webhook is fine, tell us the endpoint or we can use the HubSpot record to exchange credentials.

Thanks — aiming to close this today so the invoice is created with the right provenance.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations // Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-invoice-draft-20251205.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@hightower.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 09:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Invoice emission path and VAT evidence — quick decision request

Hi Ben,

Thanks — AP prefers the portal push whenever possible. We get faster matching that way. Our PO is HWT-2219 and VAT ID is IT12345678901.

One note from our security/compliance: the portal integration must use mutual TLS or a pre-shared HMAC token. We cannot accept invoices via email unless they are uploaded manually by our AP analyst (which introduces delays).

If you can provide the webhook spec and a sample ack payload, I'll pass it to our AP platform team.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance Operations, Hightower Health
elena.rossi@hightower.io

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Invoice emission path and VAT evidence — webhook spec and next steps

Elena — perfect, thanks for the quick reply.

Connor: can you confirm our webhook payload includes the VAT fields Elena requested and whether we support HMAC token auth or mTLS for the outbound call? I've attached a short spec (portal-webhook-spec.md) and a draft invoice PDF for visibility.

Elena — once Connor confirms auth we can do a test push to a staging endpoint; we'll include an 'invoice_hash' and 'evidence.attached_vat_id' in the JSON so your system can auto-attach the evidence to the invoice record.

If AP needs an email fallback we will send the signed PDF and include a one-time token in the subject line so you can correlate it to HWT-2219.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachment: portal-webhook-spec.md (Markdown, 4KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@hightower.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Dec 2025 14:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Invoice emission path and VAT evidence — auth, signing, and fallback plan

Hi team,

Quick tech notes:
- Our invoicing service supports HMAC token auth (rotating tokens per partner) and can be configured for mTLS if Hightower's platform prefers client certs.
- Payload includes: invoice_id, invoice_hash (SHA256), line_items[], currency, vat_breakdown[], reverse_charge boolean, buyer_vat_id.
- We will set the HTTP response validation to only accept 200 OK with a JSON ack containing 'ack_id' + timestamp. That ack becomes the canonical proof of delivery in our billing audit trail.

Email fallback: we can S/MIME-sign the PDF but note that your AP platform does not automatically ingest signed emails — it requires manual upload. If you must use email for the first invoice we can also include a single-use webtoken in the message body that, when clicked by your AP analyst, pulls the invoice into portal staging and issues an ack. That preserves automated traceability while working around ingestion limits.

Neha: can you handle the operational piece for this account? If AP confirms staging endpoint, send a rotation token and coordinate the staging push. Also add a billing contact alias for Hightower (e.g., billing+hightower@redwood.com) so replies are automatically routed.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Platform Integrations // Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

Attachment: dkim-signing-check.txt (TXT, 1KB)
